verdict.rationale: Syncing saved hosts and connection settings across devices is a fair question for a Git client like Working Copy. The evidence never documents syncing hosting-provider configurations, identities or connection settings between devices. The Auto-Sync and Background Sync features commit, pull and push repository content, which is an adjacent capability, and the pro-purchase migration moved data between app versions, not across devices.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can sync my saved hosts and connection settings across all my devices
